verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists "Receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses," and its developer API mentions a receipts surface. Together these suggest mobile photo capture of receipts exists as a first-party feature, but the evidence is a single thin marketing line. missing for 10: email-forwarding receipt capture, documented OCR extraction of receipt fields, automatic matching of receipts to the correct card transaction, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration.
